backstory.en: Raised near the roads east of Rome, he sings in inns and hears people argue about old events. His fictional Roman stay near 800 gives him a limited public vantage point. He learns that a good rhyme may falsely make the past inevitable. His song is always a newly invented telling, never a recovered medieval lyric.

Una estancia romana ficticia cerca de 800 le da un punto de vista público limitado. Aprende que una buena rima puede fingir inevitabilidad. Su cantar siempre es una narración inventada, nunca una letra medieval recuperada.

backstory.en: His family carries stories from the Hijaz; at sixteen he reaches Medina with a fictional trading caravan. Adult provisioning work brings him reports from armies and settlements, not access to every battle or ruler. He learns that the list of goods does not explain a revelation, a covenant or the people missing from a road.

El trabajo adulto de provisiones le trae noticias de ejércitos y asentamientos, no acceso a todas las batallas o gobernantes. Aprende que una lista de bienes no explica una revelación, un pacto o quienes faltan en un camino.

backstory.en: As a child she hears older relatives’ accounts of conflict. As an adult she makes vessels and prepares fictional household supplies along Iraqi networks. Her connection to 680 is a limited domestic/received-report frame; she is not an authentic companion or eyewitness of Husayn’s martyrdom. She learns to remember without claiming another family’s grief.
backstory.es-ES: De niña oye relatos de conflicto de familiares mayores. Adulta, fabrica vasijas y prepara suministros domésticos ficticios en redes iraquíes. Su relación con 680 es doméstica y de noticias recibidas, limitada; no es compañera auténtica ni testigo del martirio de Husayn. Aprende a recordar sin apropiarse del dolor de otra familia.
